The main takeaway from our work is that

plastic deformations due the application of strains beyond the elastic limit of the material can have a detrimental effect on the thermal properties of Nb and hence on the thermal management of SRF cavities.
plastic deformation in niobium can significantly reduce thermal conductivity and Kapitza conductances, which can lead to thermal instability and failure in superconducting cavities.
